title: chant broker protocol, version 1
description: The bodies a box and its broker exchange (#3164, ws-097). A box holds no credential: each capability its box block declares is reached through a broker, which holds the credential, swaps the box's own token for it, and refuses what the box's declaration does not allow. Each $def is one body; broker-protocol.ts names the routes, and the broker conformance suite in @intentius/chant/workspace/conformance checks an implementation. Unknown fields are ignored by readers and a field is only ever added within a version.

capabilityName.description: A capability's name, as the box block gives it: inference, egress, feedback, fountain, or one a lexicon or runtime adds.

scopeWord.description: One word of a capability's scope. The broker reads it; chant records it.

capability.description: One entry of a box block's capabilities, as chant workspace status --json lists it.

broker.description: The broker the box block names for the capability. A broker keeps only the entries that name it.

declarationReport.description: POST /api/box/declaration: the capabilities chant workspace status --json lists for the box's block, sent by the box's steward with the box's own token, and, optionally, the box's listing and this month's spend (#3508, ws-102). At most 32 KB. Each report replaces the last.

declarationKept.description: The 200 answer to a report: the entries the broker keeps, those that name it, each name once, and when it took them.

listing.description: The report's listing, when the broker keeps one.

spend.description: The report's spend, when the broker keeps one.

listing.description: Optional in a report, added within version 1 by #3508 (ws-102). The box block's listing (ws-077) as chant workspace status --json prints it, less the cover: what a broker that lists boxes lists this one under. The bounds are the ones chant workspace box listing set writes with. A broker that lists no boxes ignores it.

published.description: Whether the box is listed for people other than its owner. Absent means true.

spend.description: Optional in a report, added within version 1 by #3508 (ws-102). What the box's run records (chant workspace runs --json, ws-076) say it spent in one calendar month, by each run's startedAt: the month's totals, and the same per principal the runs worked for. Only USD costs are summed: a run with no USD cost is counted in unpriced, never as zero. spendFromRuns in broker-protocol.ts computes it. A broker that reports no spend ignores it.

byPrincipal.description: Per principal, as the run records' by names them (ws-080's form), at most 50; principal is null for the runs that name none.

spendUsd.description: The sum of the priced runs' USD costs.

spendCount.description: A count of runs: all of them under runs, those with no USD cost under unpriced.

payer.description: Whose credential pays for the box's model calls (#3474, ws-098), when the broker says. shared: a credential neither the box's owner nor its visitor owns, such as a house or operator key. owner: the box owner's own. visitor: the credential a person brought for this box. principal is the payer in ws-080's form (github:<login>) when the broker knows them, else null. Optional: a broker that does not say leaves it out, and a box treats that as unknown. The same fact rides on each answer from /llm/anthropic and /decide as the chant-payer header.

refusal.description: The body of every refusal: error is the message, or an object holding it. A refusal by declaration is a 403 whose message names the capability and the scope word the box would have to declare.

decideRequest.description: POST /decide/v1/systemone: chant's decide wire format (#2491, op/decide-backend.ts), asked with the box's token as the bearer.

decideAnswer.description: One answer. reason is the model's own explanation (#3345); chant keeps it in the answer record.

decideResponse.description: The 200 answer: the model that answered, as the request pinned it, and one answer per question asked.

feedbackBatch.description: POST /api/feedback: a box's agents' feedback (studio#257). entries needs feedback scope agent, counts needs passive; a batch carries at least one. What an entry holds is the receiver's wire format, not this protocol's.
